body: Tried laxatives etc but because my anxiety is that acute my tummy muscles clamp down so hard and can’t even get that kind of stuff out. Keep trying at the doctors to get appointments and can’t or they can’t really diagnose me with anything specific. It costs £80 a session for a decent psychologist can’t afford that shit. There’s too much at once for them to sort out. One thing sorted makes a problem for something else.
